title: Mower Mayhem
tagline: Steer your electric Mower round ten walled Lawns and cut every blade, but never touch the Hedgehog, the Cat or the Bird.
blurb: Steer your electric Mower round ten walled Lawns and cut every blade, but never touch the Hedgehog, the Cat or the Bird. Zap the Weeds with the Trimmer, watch the Battery and park on the Dock before it runs flat. Mow a perfect Lawn for a fat bonus, to a 128 tune you can switch off with M.

review.verdict: Cuts a fine figure for the price, though a few Weeds leave it a little ragged round the edges.

quote.text: Racing the Battery gauge down to the Dock with the warning going is proper edge-of-the-seat stuff

credits.name: Gaz Pocket, Prue Fairley and Norm Crabtree for INK & PAPER
